newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Irish conference will enhance EU rural development role.
newsitem.headline: Irish conference will enhance EU rural development role.

text.p: A European Union conference on rural development next month will enhance the role of rural development policy, a European Commission spokesman said on Friday.
It will be held in Cork, Ireland, from November 7-8.

"Traditionally rural development has been overshadowed by agricultural policy. The Cork conference will aim at raising the profile of rural development and rebalancing its importance relative to agriculture," spokesman Gerard Kiely said.
"EU and eastern European Ministers will be at Cork debating the future development of rural policy and the conclusions of the conference will be put to EU heads of government in December," he added.

The conference, to be chaired by former European Parliament President Lord Plumb, will debate the policies needed to meet the needs of rural areas which account for 80 percent of the EU's land area and a quarter of its population.
In a series of speeches and statements EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler has said that agriculture and rural development must be part of an integrated rural development policy. REUTER
